WELCOME TO CROSSPOINT

A place the body of believers gather in corporate worship, disciple making, and sending each other out into the world for the name of Christ Jesus.

Join us this sunday at: 150 Alum springs road, lynchburg, va 24502
SERvice times: Sundays at 9:00 & 11:00 am

We're all about JESUS, making discipleS, and furthering his Kingdom

Our mission is to glorify God by making disciples of Jesus in the power of the Holy Spirit. 

CONNECTING PEOPLE

Connecting people emphasizes that every first-time guest can easily discover how to plug into this community and further their walk with Jesus. We believe this connection point to be essential in the life of a believer as they grow in following Jesus. 

DEVELOPING DISCIPLES

We develop disciples through large gatherings of corporate worship each weekend, small groups where an atmosphere for connection and forming deeper relationships are curated, and through discipleship bands where 3-5 people commit to walk as Jesus walked together in frequent meetings and discussions.

DEPLOYING DISCIPLE MAKERS

We aim to be a church that equips and empowers disciples to live as everyday missionaries wherever they live, work, and play. Deploy Crosspoint does this through learning cohorts and residencies that help disciples discover their calling, live out the gospel, and prepares them to multiply in any environment.

Kids In Worship Grant Initiative

Intergenerational worship is generations coming together to worship intentionally, relationally, and mutually – serving, sharing, and learning alongside one another and together as the body of Christ. It’s about adults modeling and mentoring kids/teens and kids/teens modeling and mentoring adults as they participate in worship together. It’s recognizing all generations have something to offer in the body of Christ.

The Wesleyan Church has a long-standing tradition of valuing children as essential members of the faith community, following Jesus’ teaching to welcome children into the Kingdom of God.
 Because of this, the denomination has created the Kids In Worship grant. The goal is to help develop churches into communities that value all generations with intention.

Crosspoint Church is the recipient in the Shenandoah District! As a result, CP staff and volunteers will receive specific training and resources on how to emphasis intergenerational worship in our church community.
